name: Mass Effect 3
source:
A playable visual novel version of Mass Effect 3 as predicted by me before the actual game came out. See new location(s)! Meet new character(s)! Romance aliens of at least two genders! Just as good as the real thing(*), and absolutely free!

(*)Disclaimer: not as good as the real thing.

[From [url=http://archiveofourown.org/works/263443]Archive of Our Own[/url]]
translation:
一部可游玩的《质量效应3》视觉小说版本，创作时间早于原作正式发售，内容正如我当时的预测。探索新地点！认识新角色！与至少两种性别的外星人谈恋爱！和真正的游戏一样精彩（*），而且完全免费！

（*）免责声明：没有真正的游戏那么好。

（来源：[url=http://archiveofourown.org/works/263443]Archive of Our Own[/url]）
